Name: AutoHarvestOutdoors
Author: Johannes0126
Description:
This is a simple mod designed to automatically harvest the yields of outdoor production tools that are not well-suited for automation connections — such as beehives, tappers, heavy tappers

I have personally tested it in several scenarios. Please feel free to let me know if you encounter any issues. Thank you!
Compatible with GMCM
You can choose to enable daily auto-harvest or manually harvest via a custom hotkey (the default hotkey is N and can be changed).

This is my first time creating a mod. If you encounter any bugs or issues, please feel free to let me know. Thank you!<b

Manifest.Name: AutoHarvestOutdoors
Manifest.Description: Auto harvest beehives, tappers, heavy tappers and mushroom logs in all maps
Manifest.Author: Johannes
